name: Notion API
description: Notion API lets your app read from and write to Notion databases · perfect for founder-editable CMS or knowledge-base backed by Notion pages.
benefits: Founder edits content in Notion · app reflects immediately
No CMS admin panel to build
Rich text · toggles · lists · tables all supported
promptTemplate: Install @notionhq/client. Create src/lib/notion/client.ts with typed page fetchers. Wire NOTION_API_KEY as server-only env var. Create /api/notion/pages route that returns cached page content. Document setup in docs/integrations/notion.md. Never commit NOTION_API_KEY.
